paite: Ka tapa, na inveng a dia moh khu dia nai dinleh mikhual a ding a na khut na kichiamleh,
heading: Thuhilhna Tamsem
english: My son, if you have become collateral for your neighbor, if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger,

paite: na kam a thute a awk na hih a, na kam a thute a mat na hihleh,
english: you are trapped by the words of your mouth; you are ensnared with the words of your mouth.

paite: tu in hiai hih in, ka tapa, nang leh nang kihonkhia in, na inveng khut sung ah na om chih thei in; kuan in, nang leh nang kiniamkhiak inla, na inveng va ngen ngutngut in.
english: Do this now, my son, and deliver yourself, since you have come into the hand of your neighbor. Go, humble yourself. Press your plea with your neighbor.

paite: Na mitte ihmusak ke'nla, na mitvunte leng lususak sam ke'n.
english: Give no sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids.

paite: Gamvakpa khut a sakhipi bang leh thangkampa khut a vasa bang in kihonkhia in.
english: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.

paite: Miksi kiang ah hoh in, nang thadah; alampite ngaihtuah inla, pil in.
english: Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;

paite: Hausa, heutu, hiam vaihawmmi, nei lou in,
english: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,

paite: nipi chiang in an asutuah ua, pawltak chiang in an akaikhawm hi.
english: provides her bread in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.

paite: Bang tan ihmu ding na hia, aw thadah? Na ihmutna a kipan chikchiang a thou ding na hia?
english: How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?

paite: Neukha ihmut lai, neukha lusuk, ihmu ding a neukha khutte khep.
english: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep—

paite: Huchi in na gentheihna guta bang in ahong pai dia, huan na taksapna mi kigalthuam bang in.
english: so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man.

paite: Miphatuamlou, migilou; kam ki-uangsak toh avak a;
english: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth,

paite: amitte in chiamtehna abawl a, akhete in thu agen a, akhutzungte in chiamtehna abawl a;
english: who winks with his eyes, who signals with his feet, who motions with his fingers,

paite: alungtang sung ah hoihlouhna a-om a, gilou agel gige a; kilemlouhna atuh naknak hi.
english: in whose heart is perverseness, who devises evil continually, who always sows discord.

paite: Huaiziak in atuahsiatna thakhat in ahong tung ding a; thakhat a kekgawp in, hihdamna bei in a-om ding hi.
english: Therefore his calamity will come suddenly. He will be broken suddenly, and that without remedy.

paite: Toupa'n amuhdah thil guk a-om a; ahi, amah a dia kihhuai sagih a-om hi.
english: There are six things which Yahweh hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:

paite: Mit ki-uangsakte, lei zuauthei, mihoih sisan suah khutte;
english: arrogant eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,

paite: Ngaihtuahna gilou ngaihtuah lungtang, siatna hih ding a kintaite;
english: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are swift in running to mischief,

paite: Zuauthu gen palai taklou, leh unaute lak a kilemlouhna chi tuh.
english: a false witness who utters lies, and he who sows discord among brothers.

paite: Ka tapa, na pa thupiak zui in, huan na nu dan mangngilh ke'n.
heading: Ang Kawm Lou Dia Hilhna
english: My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.

paite: Na lungtang tung ah vial gige inla, na ngawng kim ah gak in.
english: Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck.

paite: Na vak chiang in, nang ahon pi ding a; na ihmut chiang in, nang ahon veng ding hi; huan na khanloh chiang in, nang ahon houpih ding hi.
english: When you walk, it will lead you. When you sleep, it will watch over you. When you awake, it will talk with you.

paite: Thupiak lah khawnvak ahi ngal a; huan dan vakna ahi; huchi in hilhna taihilhna hinna lampi ahi.
english: For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,

paite: Numei gilou a kipan leh mikhual lei maitang phatna a kipan in nang hon kem ding hi.
english: to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.

paite: Na lungtang in akilawmna lunggulh ke'n; amitvunte'n nang hon man kei hen.
english: Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.

paite: Numei kizuaknu ziak in pasal tanghou them a mat in a-om hi; huchi in angkawmnu'n hinna manpha azong sek hi.
english: For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life.

paite: Mi'n a-angsung ah mei ala thei diam, apuante akang kei diam?
english: Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned?

paite: Ahihkeileh mi suangkuangthei sa tung ah avak thei diam, akhete akang kei diam?
english: Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?

paite: Huchibang in kuapeuh invengte zi zuan; kuapeuh amah khoih gawt louh a-om kei ding.
english: So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished.

paite: Guta in agilkial ziak a alunggulhna taisak ding kia a agukleh mite'n guta amusit kei uhi.
english: Men don’t despise a thief if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry,

paite: Himahleh muh a a-omleh, azah sagih in adin ding a; a-inn a van tengteng ape ding hi.
english: but if he is found, he shall restore seven times. He shall give all the wealth of his house.

paite: Kuapeuh angkawm theihsiamna bei ahi; amah kha hihse ding a ahih ahi.
english: He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul.

paite: Liamnate leh zumhuaite amu ding; huan azahpihhuaina nulmang ahi kei ding.
english: He will get wounds and dishonor. His reproach will not be wiped away.

paite: Mullitna lah mi thangpaihna ahi ngal a; huchi in phulak ni chiang in ahawi kei ding hi.
english: For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband. He won’t spare in the day of vengeance.

paite: Tatna alimsak kei ding a; thilpiak tampi pe lechin leng, lungdam in a-om kei ding hi.
english: He won’t regard any ransom, neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.
